kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day
title: Sautéed Chicken Livers with Onion and Garlic

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day
title: Transylvanian Garlic Aubergine Dip

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day
title: Mussels alla marinara with lemon

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day
title: Garlic Bread with Herb Butter

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day
title: Bagna cauda

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day
title: Spicy Garlic Toast

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

kicker: From the Kitchen — Recipe of the Day

title: Garlic Cheese Spread
meta: Serves 6. Preparation, 15 minutes; no cooking required.
body: **Ingredients:** Palouček cream cheese, blue cheese, garlic, mayonnaise, chives, ham
Grate the garlic finely and the blue cheese coarsely. Mix the cream cheese, both cheeses, crushed garlic, mayonnaise, chopped chives and finely diced ham into a spread.

title: Roast Garlic Ribs with Mashed Potatoes
body: **Ingredients:** pork ribs, garlic, lard, salt, pepper, caraway, water

Salt the ribs cut between the bones, add pepper, sprinkle with caraway and arrange on a tray, then add chopped garlic, lard and water. Cover with dampened baking paper and roast at 180 °C for 20 minutes, then at 150 °C for 1.5–2 hours; serve with mashed potatoes.

title: Tripe Soup
body: **Ingredients:** beef tripe, onion, lard, plain flour, ground sweet paprika, caraway, garlic, marjoram, pepper, salt

Blanch the tripe several times, cook until soft and cut into strips. Make a roux from onion, flour and paprika, pour in the tripe cooking liquid, add caraway and pepper and cook; stir in mashed garlic, the tripe and finally marjoram rubbed between your palms.

title: Roasted Garlic Rosemary Potato Slices
body: **Ingredients:** potatoes with skin, garlic, olive oil, rosemary, salt
Cut the potatoes, skin on, into thin slices. Mix the garlic with olive oil, salt and coarsely chopped rosemary, brush it over the potato slices on a greased baking sheet and roast until golden.

title: Garlic-Butter Fish-Sauce Wings
body: **Ingredients:** chicken wings, butter, chopped garlic, fish sauce, sugar, oil, pepper

Fry the chicken wings until golden and crisp and remove them to drain. Over low heat melt the butter, fry the chopped garlic, add the fish sauce and sugar and stir gently until the sauce thickens. Add the wings and coat them in the garlic-butter glaze over low heat, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

title: Tender Garlic Turkey Leg with Roast Potatoes
meta: Serves 4. Preparation, 20 minutes; cooking, 2 hours 30 minutes.
body: **Ingredients:** turkey leg, garlic, rosemary, salt, pepper, beer, olive oil, butter, potatoes, onion

Place the scored, seasoned leg with garlic and rosemary in the cuts into a baking dish, drizzle with beer and olive oil. Roast covered at 140 °C for 2.5 hours, basting regularly with butter and the beer marinade; serve with pre-boiled roast potatoes.
